usedFor: Aura logs leads and payments, using “Create Lead” and “Record Payment” to put new details into your account.

bestTemplate.name: “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo, then “Create Lead” in Aura
bestTemplate.why: An incoming message becomes a lead with an email, so nobody retypes the sender's details.

watchOut: “Verify Payment” links a payment to a specific call, so that call has to exist before the step runs.
